evaluation_protocol.falsification_condition: Reject if preparation, probe, retained/closed partition, readout, post-state, instrument or condition is erased; if an unrecorded predecessor is claimed reconstructible; if any of nine NIST package files, 330 data rows or 796 cells changes; if the complete event surface does not retain 50 real-time readouts, 117 J=2 intervals, 55 J=1 intervals, six prepared-sublevel rows, four recovery classes, 71 tracking intervals, four pressure-control rows and 23 appearance-time rows; if the one reported zero-duration tracking boundary is discarded or consumed as a number; if any target enters before sealing; or if a stochastic/fitted model selects the law.

external_measurement_sources.measurement_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology
